answer: Last month this network paid 7,400 POA to 212 keys minted in one afternoon, so session keys now bind to work. Each identity rotates its signing key every 4 epochs, and a new key issues only if the prior window produced 3 graded submissions. One upheld challenge revokes the active key in 1 epoch, and 3 revocations inside 90 days close the whole terrace, grove and all. Honest work costs about 18 minutes of compute per window. The cheapest farming path is 212 keys times 3 submissions times 4 epochs of presence plus a cipher refresh per key, which prices above the reward at current emission.
